reader.requirement: The operand of an indexed-file REWRITE must be record-name-1, the name of a logical (level-01) record in the File Section, qualified where needed (by record or file name); a Working-Storage item, a subordinate item, a reference-modified record, a file-name, or the later FILE file-name-1 form must be refused at 85, and a qualified record-name must bind to the right file.

edition-consulted.switches: the word RECORD after record-name refused below 2002

reader.edition-search: ResolveRecordName and ResolveRewriteRecord contain no edition test (read whole); the edition consults are the parse-time gates in VersionConformancePass.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: from 2002 REWRITE also takes the FILE file-name-1 alternative; at 85 only record-name-1. The record-name check itself is the same code at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb347_record_name_identity exercises the qualified record-name acceptance on a sequential file; the indexed arm, the refusals (WS item, subordinate item, ref-mod, ambiguous name, file-name, FILE form) are not in the witness.

probes.printed: RW1 00 / RW2 00 / RW3 INV 23 / N1 K1123 / N2 K2ZZZ
probes.expected: REWRITE REC-A OF FX (qualified, same name in FY) and REWRITE REC-B (second record of FX) replace the right records; non-existent key gives invalid key 23

probes.printed: error COBOL1757: REWRITE 'WS-REC' ... is not a logical record of any file description entry
probes.expected: refused: not a File Section record

probes.printed: error COBOL1757: ... is subordinate to 'REC-A', which is the logical record of 'FX'
error COBOL1639: 'REC-A' does not uniquely identify a data item
probes.expected: refused: must be qualified to be unique

probes.printed: error COBOL1757: record-name-1 is a record-name, not an identifier, so it shall not be reference-modified
error COBOL1639: 'FX' is declared as a file-name ... not as a data item
probes.expected: refused: a file-name is not a record-name

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: the FILE phrase of a WRITE or REWRITE statement requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.6.3 SR2  (4.6.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2

reader.notes: Every refusal and the qualified acceptance behave per the 1985 rule. COBOL1757 messages cite §2023:14.9.35.3 SR1 and print the qualified operand with its spaces dropped ('FX-DATAOFREC-AOFFX'), cosmetic only.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:IX.4.6.2-4.6.4. Run at --std 85: REWRITE REC-A OF FX of a GLOBAL indexed FD from a contained program (q8glob) accepted and rewrites (IN 00 / OUT K1ZZZ 00); REWRITE of the second (implicitly redefining) record REC-B of an EXTERNAL random indexed FD (q9ext) accepted (RW 00 / OUT K1QQQ 00). Refusals: REWRITE of an SD record (q10sd) COBOL1692 + COBOL1720; REWRITE of a Linkage Section 01 (q11lnk) COBOL1757 'not a logical record of any file description entry'. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IX.4.6.3 SR2  (4.6.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2'.
